speaker: dagna_holt
text: Form up. Nobody dies stupid.

speaker: dagna_holt
text: Eyes front. Shields up.
renderText: Eyes front. Shields up.

speaker: dagna_holt
text: Right. Let's earn our bread.
renderText: Right. Let's earn our bread.

speaker: dagna_holt
text: Mine.
renderText: Mine.

speaker: dagna_holt
text: Moving.
renderText: Moving.

speaker: dagna_holt
text: Down.
renderText: Down.

speaker: dagna_holt
text: Stay there.
renderText: Stay there.

speaker: dagna_holt
text: Damn it.
renderText: Damn it.

speaker: dagna_holt
text: That's for the bridge.
renderText: That's for the bridge.

speaker: dagna_holt
text: Done.
renderText: Done.

speaker: dagna_holt
text: One less.
renderText: One less.

speaker: dagna_holt
text: Someone's down! Cover them!
renderText: Someone's down! Cover them!

speaker: dagna_holt
text: Not again. Not on my watch.
renderText: Not again. Not on my watch.

speaker: dagna_holt
text: Had worse. Not much worse.
renderText: Had worse. Not much worse.

speaker: dagna_holt
text: Ta. Back in.
renderText: Ta. Back in.

speaker: dagna_holt
text: Still here. Don't fuss.
renderText: Still here. Don't fuss.

speaker: dagna_holt
text: Count heads. Everyone? Good.
renderText: Count heads. Everyone? Good.

speaker: dagna_holt
text: That'll do.
renderText: That'll do.

speaker: dagna_holt
text: Fall back! Back, now!
renderText: Fall back! Back, now!

speaker: dagna_holt
text: Sleep. I'll take the watch. Habit.
renderText: Sleep. I'll take the watch. Habit.

speaker: dagna_holt
text: Don't tell me it'll be all right. Tell me what we're doing.
renderText: Don't tell me it'll be all right. Tell me what we're doing.

speaker: dagna_holt
text: Don't tell me it'll be all right. Tell me what we're doing.
renderText: Don't tell me it'll be all right. Tell me what we're doing.

speaker: dagna_holt
text: Form up. Nobody dies stupid.
renderText: Form up. Nobody dies stupid.

speaker: dagna_holt
text: Right. Let's earn our bread.
renderText: Right. Let's earn our bread.

speaker: dagna_holt
text: Skarrow counts mouths. Varrow counts sacks. I used to think a guard only had to count spears.
renderText: Skarrow counts mouths. Varrow counts sacks. I used to think a guard only had to count spears.

speaker: dagna_holt
text: Coll had a little girl. Skarrow has a whole hill of them. Don't ask me to make that come out even. Just... don't let me forget either side.
renderText: Coll had a little girl. Skarrow has a whole hill of them. Don't ask me to make that come out even. Just... don't let me forget either side.

speaker: dagna_holt
text: He keeps saying we must trust him. A captain who has to say that has usually stopped listening.
renderText: He keeps saying we must trust him. A captain who has to say that has usually stopped listening.

speaker: dagna_holt
text: Then we'd better learn how to give something back.
renderText: Then we'd better learn how to give something back.

speaker: dagna_holt
text: Killed two of my guards doing it. Coll and Annet. Good people.
renderText: Killed two of my guards doing it. Coll and Annet. Good people.

speaker: dagna_holt
text: Forty winters she's led them. Clever. She'll smile at you while her archers find the range.
renderText: Forty winters she's led them. Clever. She'll smile at you while her archers find the range.

speaker: dagna_holt
text: Calm's for after. Bridge first.
renderText: Calm's for after. Bridge first.

speaker: dagna_holt
text: Aye. You were. Not many of us walked off it.
renderText: Aye. You were. Not many of us walked off it.

speaker: dagna_holt
text: You saw what they did. When the time comes, you tell them.
renderText: You saw what they did. When the time comes, you tell them.

speaker: dagna_holt
text: Hit them at dawn, from both banks. They'll break. Goblins always break.
renderText: Hit them at dawn, from both banks. They'll break. Goblins always break.

speaker: dagna_holt
text: Say that again.
renderText: Say that again.

speaker: dagna_holt
text: Coll always had a nervous bow hand. I sent him out at first light because I trusted him. Children.
renderText: Coll always had a nervous bow hand. I sent him out at first light because I trusted him. Children.

speaker: dagna_holt
text: Two of mine are still dead. But I'll want a better reason than hunger now, and I haven't got one.
renderText: Two of mine are still dead. But I'll want a better reason than hunger now, and I haven't got one.

speaker: dagna_holt
text: Here's mine. Every day we talk, the road stays shut. Talk is a luxury, and we've eleven days of it.
renderText: Here's mine. Every day we talk, the road stays shut. Talk is a luxury, and we've eleven days of it.

speaker: dagna_holt
text: They chose spears over asking. Answer the spears, and the next hungry clan knows what that bridge costs.
renderText: They chose spears over asking. Answer the spears, and the next hungry clan knows what that bridge costs.

speaker: dagna_holt
text: Twenty crowns. My own. Now choose.
renderText: Twenty crowns. My own. Now choose.

speaker: dagna_holt
text: Good. Dawn, then, from both banks. I'll have the guards in the reeds before first light.
renderText: Good. Dawn, then, from both banks. I'll have the guards in the reeds before first light.

speaker: dagna_holt
text: Talk, then. When she puts a spear through you, remember who told you she would.
renderText: Talk, then. When she puts a spear through you, remember who told you she would.

speaker: dagna_holt
text: Now. Before she says anything else.
renderText: Now. Before she says anything else.

speaker: dagna_holt
text: Children. Our lads shot at children.
renderText: Children. Our lads shot at children.

speaker: dagna_holt
text: And we've just finished what they started. Gods help me.
renderText: And we've just finished what they started. Gods help me.

speaker: dagna_holt
text: The road's open. That's what we came for.
renderText: The road's open. That's what we came for.

speaker: dagna_holt
text: Funny. I thought this would feel like something.
renderText: Funny. I thought this would feel like something.

speaker: dagna_holt
text: Truce or no truce, they're on my bridge. Ready when you are.
renderText: Truce or no truce, they're on my bridge. Ready when you are.

speaker: dagna_holt
text: Bridge is clear. Carts can cross by noon.
renderText: Bridge is clear. Carts can cross by noon.

speaker: dagna_holt
text: I wanted her dead, you know. For Coll and Annet. I still might, some days.
renderText: I wanted her dead, you know. For Coll and Annet. I still might, some days.

speaker: dagna_holt
text: But I've never seen goblins carry their own children off a bridge before. I'll think on it.
renderText: But I've never seen goblins carry their own children off a bridge before. I'll think on it.

speaker: dagna_holt
text: The goblins, Halden. They want feeding. We gave our word.
renderText: The goblins, Halden. They want feeding. We gave our word.

speaker: dagna_holt
text: Halden. You locked those gates in the spring, before the clan ever came down. I want to know why.
renderText: Halden. You locked those gates in the spring, before the clan ever came down. I want to know why.

speaker: dagna_holt
text: Six years. I've sat at your table for six years.
renderText: Six years. I've sat at your table for six years.

speaker: dagna_holt
text: Aye. Somebody has to count the sacks honestly.
renderText: Aye. Somebody has to count the sacks honestly.

speaker: dagna_holt
text: The bridge is open. Nobody tolls it. I'd like to say it was worth it. Some days I can.
renderText: The bridge is open. Nobody tolls it. I'd like to say it was worth it. Some days I can.

speaker: dagna_holt
text: They remember the bridge. So do I. That's the trouble with remembering. It works on both sides.
renderText: They remember the bridge. So do I. That's the trouble with remembering. It works on both sides.

speaker: dagna_holt
text: The ford first. I have too few guards to bury another.
renderText: <Low, flat Northern soldier; restrained gratitude, no ceremony. Mood: idle.> The ford first. I have too few guards to bury another.

delivery.direction: Low, flat Northern soldier; restrained gratitude, no ceremony.

speaker: dagna_holt
text: Now a grey bear takes goats from the pens. The boy got out; Maud has him by her fire. The cave mouth is below her hut on the burned bank. Will you put an end to this?
renderText: <Low, flat Northern soldier; restrained gratitude, no ceremony. Mood: idle.> Now a grey bear takes goats from the pens. The boy got out; Maud has him by her fire. The cave mouth is below her hut on the burned bank. Will you put an end to this?

speaker: dagna_holt
text: Bring the ember-claw back. Sixty gold and a fitted trinket each. I will keep gifts for anyone away. Go carefully; that bear has lived through more winters than this Watch.
renderText: <Low, flat Northern soldier; restrained gratitude, no ceremony. Mood: idle.> Bring the ember-claw back. Sixty gold and a fitted trinket each. I will keep gifts for anyone away. Go carefully; that bear has lived through more winters than this Watch.

speaker: dagna_holt
text: Then take the time. Cold courage does nobody any good.
renderText: <Low, flat Northern soldier; restrained gratitude, no ceremony. Mood: idle.> Then take the time. Cold courage does nobody any good.

delivery.direction: Low, flat Northern soldier; restrained gratitude, no ceremony.

speaker: dagna_holt
text: Below Maud’s hut. Follow the miners’ track. Come back with the claw, and with every soul you take in.
renderText: <Low, flat Northern soldier; restrained gratitude, no ceremony. Mood: idle.> Below Maud’s hut. Follow the miners’ track. Come back with the claw, and with every soul you take in.

speaker: dagna_holt
text: Tobin can work with this. Your gold is counted, and there is a rare trinket fitted to each of your callings. Accepting replaces any trinket you already wear. Shall I present them?

speaker: dagna_holt
text: They will stay here. A promise does not spoil overnight.
renderText: <Low, flat Northern soldier; restrained gratitude, no ceremony. Mood: idle.> They will stay here. A promise does not spoil overnight.

delivery.direction: Low, flat Northern soldier; restrained gratitude, no ceremony.

speaker: dagna_holt
text: For the ones here, and the ones we expect home. The Watch remembers who stood for this town.
renderText: <Low, flat Northern soldier; restrained gratitude, no ceremony. Mood: idle.> For the ones here, and the ones we expect home. The Watch remembers who stood for this town.

speaker: dagna_holt
text: The pens are quiet. The boy is home. That is enough good news for one day.
